newsitem.title: CHINA: China to donate 80,000 tonnes of grain to N.Korea.
newsitem.headline: China to donate 80,000 tonnes of grain to N.Korea.

text.p: China on Tuesday informed North Korea that it was donating a further 80,000 tonnes of grain to its famine-stricken neighbour, the Xinhua news agency said.
"This decision reflects the Chinese government's consistent stand and desire to treasure and actively develop Sino-Korean traditional friendly relations," Xinhua said.
"The (North) Korean side expressed its heartfelt gratitude toward the Chinese government's friendly measure," it said.
North Korea, hit by floods and failed harvests, is on the brink of starvation, international aid workers say.
In April, China said it would donate 70,000 tonnes of grain to North Korea to help its communist neighbour overcome severe food shortages.
